summary: IMC Rare Earths filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing operational progress at its Itarantim rare earth project in Brazil. The company is launching mid-November diamond drilling at 29 Block D locations to test mineralization below the 30-meter auger limit, while consultancy WSP leads a Block A in-situ recovery field program with injection testing targeted for Q1 2027 and 37 groundwater monitoring wells. No transactional, capital-structure, or control event is disclosed; there are no deal terms, no advisor mandate tied to a transaction, and no board recommendation. This is an ordinary operations update and monitoring item, not a special situation.
